plugins.name: crash_logger
plugins.reason: writes v3x/crash.log on a crash: the evidence a player sends with a bug report; read-only

plugins.name: content_packs
plugins.reason: file overrides from v3x/content_packs/; inert without packs; needed by mod_menu, loc_fallback, script_ext

plugins.name: mod_menu
plugins.reason: the main-menu "V3X" button: the player's on/off switch for every other plugin; fails closed to the vanilla menu

plugins.name: script_ext
plugins.reason: passive: hooks nothing; lets plugins ship script/loc/gui packs via content_packs

plugins.name: keep_history
plugins.reason: country graphs are no longer wiped when switching country; played 4h

plugins.name: ironman_console
plugins.reason: developer console usable in ironman (multiplayer stays blocked); off because it can matter for achievements

plugins.name: log_filter
plugins.reason: drops noisy engine log lines; played 4h

plugins.name: frame_pacer

plugins.name: cpu_sched
plugins.reason: P-/E-core placement on hybrid CPUs, nothing on other CPUs; played 4h

plugins.name: gfx_driver
plugins.reason: fewer D3D11 driver threads; retries without the flag on failure; played 4h

plugins.name: mem_tuner
plugins.reason: lower memory commit, one out-of-memory rescue; played 4h

plugins.name: fast_load
plugins.reason: load timeline + load_transition events other plugins use; optional speedups stay off; played 4h

plugins.name: console_plus
plugins.reason: Tab completion of console arguments; catalog says not run in game and it had a crash fixed recently (crash6)

plugins.name: loc_fallback
plugins.reason: English text for keys a mod did not translate; useful for non-English players

plugins.name: asset_stream
plugins.reason: forces the texture streamer on; opt-in (its own default is off too)

plugins.name: sim_opt
plugins.reason: simulation changes (throttle) are opt-in; single player only; back up saves first

plugins.name: map_cache

plugins.reason: default mode=measure (reports only)

plugins.name: lazy_gfx
plugins.reason: default mode=measure (reports only); not run in game

plugins.reason: SDK example plugin, logs only

plugins.reason: per-tick-task timing for developers
